title: Evaluation of an algebraic normal form
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $c$ assign a coefficient in $_2$ to each subset of $_n$, and let $x in _2^n$. The evaluation of the algebraic normal form with coefficients $c$ at $x$ is the sum, over all subsets $S$ of $_n$, of $c(S)$ times the monomial indexed by $S$ evaluated at $x$.
